description: This file defines functions and types related to resolving and managing channel account contexts, including handling read-only and strict modes, diagnostics, and account state evaluation.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: getBooleanField
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean field from a record, returning undefined if not present or not a boolean.

methods.name: formatContextDiagnostic
methods.description: Formats a diagnostic message string with optional command name, plugin ID, account ID, and message.

methods.name: resolveDefaultChannelAccountContext
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the default channel account context, handling strict and read-only modes, including diagnostics and error handling.
